meta.settlement: Closing line and closing price in the nflverse schedules extract; pushes are returned at zero stake and excluded from the win-rate denominator.
meta.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg q=0.10 across every measured variant in this file.
meta.breakeven_note: At -110 a bettor needs 52.381% of decided bets just to break even.
meta.headline: No candidate passes all ten gates. The blocker for every one of them is structural, not statistical: G1 cannot be evidenced from this extract (no timestamped line, no committed lineup snapshot). That is the finding that should drive the next decision.
meta.caveat: Measured on the committed extract only. Not betting advice, and no reward is funded by anything on this site.

gates.name: Point-in-time integrity
gates.detail: FAIL (structural): the extract carries one un-timestamped closing line per game, so 'the line as it stood when the bet was made' cannot be evidenced. No lineup or injury snapshot is committed either. See flagged page IR-06/IR-07.

gates.name: Sample size
gates.detail: 66 settled bets; power-analysis minimum for this effect is 9,014 at 80% power

gates.name: Out-of-sample
gates.detail: all bets are from 2023 onward, after every fitted input

gates.name: Significance after multiple testing
gates.detail: two-sided p=0.8674; Benjamini-Hochberg q=0.10 across 23 variants -> rejected

gates.name: Positive lower bound
gates.detail: 95% bootstrap ROI interval [-0.2063, 0.2462]

gates.name: Stability
gates.detail: positive in 2/4 seasons; largest season share of positive profit 0.62

gates.name: Beats the closing line
gates.detail: settled at the closing line in the extract, not at an assumed price

gates.name: Survives luck adjustment
gates.detail: share of random same-size portfolios at the same prices that matched or beat this ROI: 0.510; deflated per-bet Sharpe threshold for 23 variants: 0.2414

gates.name: Price robustness
gates.detail: ROI 0.0196 at the extract's own price, 0.0138 if every leg were priced -110

gates.name: No hindsight selection
gates.detail: candidate rules are fixed in code before evaluation; no threshold was tuned on test data
